title: mem plan --json and mem roadmap --json (read mode)
description: plan.md, verbatim — the orchestrator parses it. Exit 1 when there is no plan.

status.description: `mem roadmap --json` only: roadmap_status from project.toml, which `mem roadmap --status` sets to draft or approved; a store written by an older mem can hold another word. Absent when unset.
